learnings.title: Shopify developer changelog feed: UI extensions now support a larger number of locales
learnings.claim: Shopify developer changelog page ui-extensions-now-support-a-larger-number-of-locales (30 Oct 2026, flag Update, surface Platform, read 2026-11-01, HTTP 200) states UI extensions no longer have a 256 KB limit on the combined size of their locale files; the 30 KB limit per individual locale file still applies. Locale file format, naming and fallback behavior are unchanged. Applies to all apps with UI extensions on all API versions; no action required, and new deploys (shopify app deploy) are not limited by combined locale size.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: only relevant if video_shopify ships UI extensions with locale files; languages previously dropped to stay under 256 KB can be re-added as long as each file stays under 30 KB. No code or operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Confirm whether video_shopify has any UI extension with a locales folder; record yes/no before 2026-11-08.
